notes.title: Akumi Wars 1.0.8 - Softlock Patch
notes.content:
[i][u][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/u][/i]
• Found a key component causing a major game freeze/softlock bug. Bug happened when knocking down and killing an enemy that has self-resurrection, for example all zombies. Engine put the “death” and “resurrection” statuses out of order confusing it and causing the engine to wait for an enemy’s turn that had already died. There could be other ways to softlock the game we haven't discovered yet. If it happens to you, press control+F11 and screen capture the green text log so we can better see what happened. [url=https://discord.gg/RWw9ejr7Dh]You can report bugs to the Akumi Wars Discord bugs channel. Thank you![/url]
• Removed normal Stumpy’s “Barkskin” when below 50% hp.
• Replaced Arcane Mage with Mage Apprentice during Mareoceu fight.
[i][u][b]New Stuffs[/b][/u][/i]
• Added new skill "Gwen’s Curse" to all shops: A curse crafted by the young lich, Gwen. Casts extinction on a single target for 3 turns! If a target is killed with this debuff, they cannot resurrect. Cooldown: 13 (Also applies Death Curse II damaging 50% of target's max HP after 2 turns!)  Well that’s convenient!
• Molly buff - Now ALL of Molly's attacks ignore dodge and counterattacks.
• Lila now opens an upgrade shop expansion in zone 1. I feel it took too long for players to gain access to upgrading skills. (Must visit Lila’s shop to unlock her upgrade add-on.)

Let's continue to improve Akumi Wars.
Onwards and Upwards!

[b][h3]Updates:[/h3][/b]
• Softlock bug for hero choices fixed.
• Placeholder video of Akumi on her phone with Drone in title the screen. We will now be able to import animated videos clips through out some cutscenes to tell stories.
• Heroes in your inventory now gain a percentage of experience from battles. We noticed heroes would quickly become a chore to level if not played and became under-leveled. Heroes must always be ready and train even when not on a mission.
• Many bosses and enemy encounters have been balanced and nerfed. The difficulty spike was too punishing.
• Discord grammar fixes completed.
• Added Zarthong skin to Bounty Hunter skin set.
• Inventory now has a 200 skill/material limit and 80 rune limit. You can still get more than the limit BUT you’ll only be able to get “first time” rewards until you sell some items to make more space. This is to avoid memory overload. Too many skills in the inventory is causing too much lag. New capacity statuses for: skills, runes and materials
• Added Game Save slots. You can now save up to 4 separate games. Pressing play will play the first game created. 
• You can now preview general rewards and first time rewards on each battle node. Currencies and rune icons will be displayed as rewards. Question mark icons will represent skill/material rewards. Face icon represents hero rewards.

• Colosseum: You now gain gold for every wave defeated after the wave 3.
• Death Matriarch/Lich Queen removed from final wave spawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/39f3067eb457132ce6b6febc5993ef2c9ab94b8b.png[/img]

• Vampirism and Chad’s Protection: added 2 turn cooldown. (All skills need a cooldown so not to get stuck in a loop in auto-battle.)
• Tempest Storm now has lower tier custom skill variants obtainable in earlier zones.
• Perfect Skull healing debuff reduced to 30% max stacks: 3. Normal Skull healing debuff reduced to 20% max stacks 3.
• Cleave, Cleave Burn now reveal stealth enemies.
• Burnout changed to Burnout Aura: Burnout Aura causes the caster and all allies to activate any burns on enemies immediately damaging them.
• Fire Ignite: (Active Skill) Activates all burns on your target immediately damaging them.
• Death Marker: Duration reduced to 2 turns.
[b][h3]New Custom Skills:[/h3][/b]
• Fiend Fire: At the end of duration, burns 10% of target's max health. Refreshing stacks will activate burn damage. Also reduces 10% turn meter.
• Fiend Blood: At the end of duration, bleeds 10% of target's max health. Refreshing stacks will activate bleed damage. Also reduces attack and 5% turn meter.
• Fiend Poison: At the end of duration, poisons 10% of target's max health. Refreshing stacks will activate poison damage. Also reduces healing and 5% turn meter.
• Unbreakable: Give 20% physical & magic defense plus 5% resistances to yourself and allies each time you defend. Max stacks: 50 Attacking dispells all buffs on yourself. Every 3 turns, taunt all enemies. Gain bubble shield when hit every 2 turns.

• Eternal Taunt: Taunts and target you attack.
• Eternal Aura: All allies gain invincibility every 5 turns for 1 turn. Before death casts Undeath on self allowing you to resurrect. Cooldown: 5
• Eternal Smite: Increases critical damage 5%. Max stacks: 100
• Eternal Sunder: All attacks increase damage received by target by 10%. Max stacks: 50
• Chaos Sickness: Chaos sickness, a terrible fate. The process of tainting it's target, it weakens but does not kill. Reducing the target's remaining health by 50%.

This is the final base game build. From here, we will fine-tune and polish the game. Stay tuned for the official release date! Thank you Backers for making this game a reality!

Onwards and Upwards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/68ee609c12a29586a61ecfe2909c25cb41708116.png[/img]

[h2]Gwen's Story[/h2]
Gwen was a mage studying in Spug City while her brother Atticus joined the Spug City paladin order. On one of his first quests, Atticus went with a party of paladins to destroy a Hellgate that had appeared in the Deadlands. Unfortunately, the demons which appeared were much stronger than reported, and Atticus and his whole party disappeared, presumed dead. After hearing the news, Gwen became obsessed with killing the demons who murdered her brother, fleeing Spug City to study the forbidden art of necromancy. Eventually, she found an original copy of the infamous Book of the Dead and transcended her mortal limitations to become a lich, a powerful undead necromancer. Her mastery of the dark arts now complete, Gwen scoured the Deadlands for any trace of the demons she had sworn to destroy. However, the Hellgate sensed her presence and hid itself, frustrating her efforts. Even worse, the very same paladin order her brother had joined declared her an abomination and placed a sizable bounty on her head, forcing her to fight off countless bounty hunters and would-be heroes. Unable to either complete her vengeance or give up, Gwen settled in the Deadlands, hoping to find any clue to the Hellgate’s location. Shortly after discovering a promising lead, Gwen got a call from Reggie about a party of bounty hunters looking for the Zombie Sisters, and agreed to guide them through the Deadlands in exchange for their help.

notes.title: The Halcyon Forest Released! - Akumi Wars Part 4
notes.content:
The Halcyon Forest was just released. This entire 4th area with new story, skills, and monsters is now available for backers of Akumi Wars on Steam! 

Within you will find Elves, Magic, and Fairies...

Beware the Fairy droppings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/93cde5593374974707ce029fcd605dd057b7de87.png[/img]

[h2]The Halcyon Forest[/h2]
The forest has the most unique variety of monsters in the game so far. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/e6ee03f365cdfe49cd33ba872ad117fe2f6f8779.png[/img]


There is a Unicorn hidden in the forest that will grant you wishes.... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/83a25b8e09f9b243e6d12b9b6140ee0de5ce6b5e.gif[/img]

This was the first time I animated a horse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/a8f1e05526863fdb7dcff9a5f99e9ba6c60d069f.gif[/img]

[h2]About those Fairy droppings.... [/h2]

If you collect the fairy stuff and grind it to power, you can turn it into a Fairy "pet" that will increase your magic power.  Well, they look like pets! They are actually back items that just look like pets. They look cool but are only visible in battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/721881883d27cd801a484f5b7d08b39153b00e16.gif[/img]

[h2]Archer[/h2]
Also the forest time I ever intricately animated a character shooting a bow. I added the sound fx to the bow. It is really satisfying to play as this character when you pull the string back and let it lose. It feels good to shoot the bow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/d7b9bb6efe44031d696065be9836b9471872fc99.gif[/img]

[h2]Marion[/h2]
Marion is a powerful arcanist. Alas, she's been manipulated by a demon aura. Snap her out of it, and you just might convince her to join your crew. However, her armament of spells is not to be taken lightly. This new character was designed for the custom backer, Bobbq (Kuppa Games)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/c39ab00539b398a88571c471593fd5fec10f092b.gif[/img]

[h2]Gilda[/h2]
I started drawing a sketch of a fantasy female dwarf. But I kept making her legs longer. The end result... meet Gilda! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/aee4bc529803e88f3daa8b975bff3d82f99ffe56.png[/img]

[h2]Gilda' Shop[/h2]
Gilda's new shop will open once you beat the final boss of Zone 3 "The Crag Keep Mountains." She sells mostly tech items.   

[h2]NEW SKILLS![/h2]
There are a ton of new skills you can get from defeating bosses or shops. There is at least one secret shop in the Fairy forest with some incredibly powerful skills. 
Arcane Blast
Mages have always found ways to manipulate energy. Your damage gains you magic defense. Activate to launch an arcane blast that does 60% of your magic defenses as damage. Will cause knockdown, killing a target will cause extinction.  (Cannot Miss)

[h2]Tempest Storm[/h2]
Lighting strikes the lowest health enemy doing 30% of their max health as damage, burning them with a chance to stun. It can also reveal stealth targets.  (Cannot Miss)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/26972a1346d928f15e739f1816aaef90c066c17f.gif[/img]

[h2]Water Elf[/h2]
This healer only appears once. If you go down one of the alternate paths towards the unicorn, you will encounter her. She can heal and resurrect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/d7b9bb6efe44031d696065be9836b9471872fc99.gif[/img]

[h2]Andrariel the Demon[/h2]
She has a cult of unkillable followers. But you know that old story about the demon snake. Cut off the demon-snake's head and the followers are soon to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/f7c617efe5c5e8b0946217e2634e29049393250c.gif[/img]

[h2]Mareoceu[/h2]
Mareoceu is the Warden of the Tree of Life. This protector of Halcyon forest and their chicken ally may be compelled to join your crew of Bounty Hunters if defeated. 

[i]"As a treant, my existence was once limited to a single spot in the forest, where I observed the natural world with a quiet introspection. But everything changed when I met Gertrudes, the chicken who now perches atop my head. 

At first, I resisted her persistent clucking and pecking, preferring my solitary existence. But as she continued to explore and experience the world around us, I found myself drawn to her adventurous spirit and her unbridled curiosity. 

Through Gertrudes' companionship, I have discovered a newfound appreciation for the beauty of the forest, from the ever-changing seasons to the diverse creatures that call it home. However, her contagious sense of adventure has left me yearning for more. 

No longer content with the static life of a treant, I now crave the thrill of exploring the outer lands with my chicken friend by my side. Together, we embark on journeys into uncharted territories, eager to discover the wonders and secrets that await us. With Gertrudes as my guide, I am no longer limited by my introverted nature, but instead, I am inspired to embrace the vastness of the world and all the possibilities it holds" [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/d59057d30d3a9406399928260c44426a22d25daa.png[/img]

[h2]More Game Updates[/h2]
Check out all of the new features, skills, and additions to Akumi Wars in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2012710/view/3692434931955621104 ]official patch notes[/url]. 

Onwards and Upwards!
-Miltonius

[h1]Kickstarter Backers & BackerKit Late Backers! Play the new area on Steam[/h1]
The newest area in Akumi Wars is now available for backers on Steam! Bring ammo and a sweater.

Thanks to everyone helping play test on the [url=http://akumiwars.com/discord]Akumi Wars Discord Server[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/b0e2a113218af5bcfc3e91de5b9717f7682b7678.png[/img]

[b]Still need your rewards?[/b]
Backers can get their [url=http://akumi-wars.backerkit.com/]Akumi Wars Kickstarter Rewards on BackerKit[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/7e38fc9b1b1e45829a2dc9c823232ac3cd3780b1.png[/img]

[h2]Enter the Crag Keep Mountains[/h2]
The deadliest technology in the Hex Realm was invented by Dwarves. Rumor has it they were responsible for creating the Timeless Titan which was seen in Spug City. Brace for mechs, robots, & power suits in this tech-filled frozen wasteland. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/304208e90f7bad547d138128f3316b30425c26d1.png[/img]

[h2]New Map[/h2]
Explore new nodes in the CragKeep Mountains. But, you will only see the first few nodes. The others are invisible until you progress through the story or discover how to unlock secret nodes.  

[b]Here's the current area list[/b]

Intro: The Prologue
Part 1: Stone Shore - Bounty Hunters, Pirates, & Bikinis
Part 2: Spug City - Princes, Paladins, & uh... Mushroom People
Part 3: Crag Keep Mountains - Chaos Demons & Dwarves
Part 4: In development now.... 
Part 5: Next
Part 6: The Finale!

[h2]Secret Nodes?[/h2]
Yup. There's at least one secret node hidden in each area. For example, go to Sprug City and battle through the Coliseum using each of the classes to unlock a great reward. As of this post, only 3 people have done it so far. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/7659802110630abe48884df374623d043577721b.png[/img]


[h2]New Monsters & Characters[/h2]
Here are some of the new characters you will find in this release...

[h2]Weather Effects! [/h2]
Rain, Thunderstorm, Snow, & Blizzards! Akumi War's programmer, Arctulius (Tulio's new name), added new particle systems to spice up the combat visuals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/5d82fb949b05741f1cf299e0e432f6d14ec55ede.png[/img]

[h2]New Victory Screen[/h2]
It now includes stats so you can see which of your crew is slacking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296115/1b09f02829350c9a8b99d56adf396d7a035229c8.png[/img]


[h2]Gem System[/h2]
You can equip gems. They are like skills. Power up your characters using gems.

Merge lesser Gems into more powerful ones.

[h2]Runes[/h2]
Equip Runes to give your cast of Bounty Hunters a boost. 


[h2]FULL PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bounty Hunter Passive (Hunter Mark: Hitting humans and droids mark them to take extra damage.)
[*] Paladin Passive (Paladin: Undead targets will be stunned and burned when attacked.)
[*] Dreadlord: Tirax will leech extra life from human targets with his attack and cause all enemies to be poisoned!
[*] 3rd Zone complete: Cragkeep Mountains.
[*] New prologue starting characters: Jade, Max and Akumi Huntress.
[*] Most heroes and enemies have skill kit updates.
[*] Guardians now gain “Rage” when hit, increasing damage. All Guardians get “Ironhide” Increasing defenses and resistances as they get hit. Allowing them to eventually resist most status effects. They also have a taunt on their default attack with a 2 turn cooldown.
[*] Chaz has a new armor skin and gains a personal custom skill that allows him to take 100% damage that would go to an ally upon himself. No cooldown.
[*] Demonkiss Shade’s ultimates now do piercing damage. Demonkiss’s default attack pierces and Demonkiss Shade special attack also pierces. Piercing attacks hit all enemies the projectile touches. Possible to hit one target twice with a single projectile.
[*] New Characters: Max, Gwen, Meka Drone, Akumi Defender (Guardian) and Akumi Warden (Support).
[*] Pirates can now steal your buffs.
[*] Molly now obtainable again. Her skill kit relies on stacking bleeds and activating them with her ult for big damage. Her default and special skills steal buffs from the enemy for herself.
[*] When Algafoffthe or Braxus hit undead targets, they stun it and cast holy fire on all enemies.
[*] When Tirax hits a human, he drains more life and casts poison on all enemies.
[*] Bounty Hunters who attack humans and droids, mark them to take 100% more damage.
[*] Most map nodes are not visible until unlocked. There are more hidden nodes to discover in each zone.
[*] Spug City now has a Colosseum with extremely difficult random enemy encounters. Colosseum drops some enemies as rewards.
[*] Preparation skills only work at the start of battle, cannot be activated manually anymore.
[*] Many new upgrade skill recipes. New chipped gems, normal gems and perfect gems with different passive procs. and stats. Gems will fit into the Preparation slot. All can be upgraded early game for major boosts.
[*] New bubble shield removing and preventing skills.
[*] Hitting a target with bubble shield will create a new impact animation and sound effect.
[*] New weather particle effects: rain, thunderstorm, snow, blizzard.
[*] Some enemies need specific strategies to beat.  All character stats will eventually be challenged.
[*] Hunter Center unlocks in Zone 1! The backer bounty hunters are not in yet... but this is where they will be once they are.
[*] All Guardian and Paladin default skill taunts now ignore resists.
[*] Azumi’s Ultimate: strikes a single target six times for 5% ( was 15% ) of target's max health. The fifth hit stuns a random enemy while the last hit activates all burns and knocks a random enemy. Shock burn duration reduced from 2 to 1.
[*] Molly’s default skill range increased from 1 to 2. Piracy: All Molly's attacks will steal a buff and apply it to herself with each hit. Stealing a team buff will apply the stolen buff to her whole team. Quick Wit: When critically, hit gains full turn meter. Adrenaline: At 50% health, Molly gains “Lucky Dodge”, significantly increasing her dodge and resistance 3 turns. Cooldown: 4. Focused: All attacks increase her critical hit chance and critical damage 10%. Max stacks: 10)
[*] Skeez’s default attack gives double Gambit bonus with each shot. Gambit: 4% increased critical chance ( was 2%) and 2% critical damage (was 1%) for each attack he does. Max stacks: 40.)  Accuracy debuff removed.
[*] Skeez’s “Boomstick” skill gets an extra turn afterwards. Removed Critical chance bonus.
[*] Skeez’s Ultimate: shoots a single target 5 times doing bonus damage for 30% of the target's lost health. These shots can knock the target down. Each shot also increases his turn meter by 10%.
[*] At 75% health, Skeez gains “Lucky Dodge”. Significantly increasing his dodge and resistance 3 turns. Cooldown: 4
[*] Paladin’s will now always stun undead targets and cast Holy Fire on the same target for more damage.
[*] Jade’s “Scattershot”: Jade shoots 3 bolts at a single target. The first shot dissolve target's bubble shield. Last hit will remove all buffs.  A second target will also be burned with each shot.
[*] Jade’s “Hadron Collider” skill no longer pierces. Jade fires a bolt at her target that will knockdown and remove all buffs. Will burn a second target with the lowest health. Ignores shields and cannot miss.
[*] Akumi Defender default skill range increased 1 to 2. Her ultimate range increased from 2 to 3. Her “Ironhide Taunt” will now ignore resists.
[*] Akumi Warden’s “Dampening Strike” will now reduces a single target’s attack80% 1 turn. It will also remove any bubble shields and prevent bubble shields for 2 turns. Her default skill and second skill range increased 1 to 2.
[*] Dwarf resistances majorly reduced. Skills: Reconstruct, Repairs, Invincible and all major defense buffs are on a long cooldowns. Resistances reduced. They can be taunted now. Still immune to stuns.
[*] Demonkiss no longer has invincible before death. Resurrect allies on longer cooldown and no longer gives extra turn.
[*] Demonkiss Shade’s resurrect allies on longer cooldown and no longer gives extra turn. Ultimate on a long cooldown
[*] Spug Grunts proc fewer buffs when healed. Lower health pool.
[*] Spug Sprite’s, Natural Cleanse, will now heal 40% of lost health.
[*] Spug Guardians no longer precast attacks. Removed mass healing and shielding.
[*] Spug Defender will precast mass bubble shields
[*] Tecnic gains Battle Frenzy and Superior Defense if his wolf is killed. Wolves gain 50% turn meter when an ally dies.
[*] Emeralds now passively heal the caster for percentage of their max health while maintaining it’s healing power and healing received bonuses.
[*] Warrior Saint: Your attacks will heal the lowest health ally 24% of their lost health while your healing power is and healing received increases 5%. Max stacks: 10 (Similar to Drones Mending Bolt.)
[*] Speed Demon gives extra turn when enemy dies. Cooldown removed.
[*] Stoneshore Gateway: removed Souless and Demonkiss the Haunted as possible spawns.
[*] Vengeance: Fight with Salty Skeltor now optional.
[*] Western Kingdom renamed “Merc Quarters”. (Braxus encounter) is now optional.
[*] Spug Gateway labeled (optional)
[*] Colosseum opens after Spug Prince cutscene.
[*] Hero rewards now show the hero's stats
[*] Rune Fusion shop added to Cragkeep Mountains. Unlocks after Grizzlespit’s upgrade shop. Take any 3 runes and fuse them for a chance at a stronger rune. This consumes the 3 runes used. The power of the 3 runes that we’re fused will determine the potential upgrade of the new rune.
[*] Fara is now “Undead” will come back to life with 40% life when killed. If protected by invincible, the Undead passive will continue to proc for 3 turns. Cooldown: 7
[*] Liv’s second skill “Heal Potions” heals 40% of lost health upon casting.
[*] Drone’s second skill “Battle Ready” heals 40% of lost health upon casting.
[*] Ironhide: All damage received increases physical defenses and resistances 30% and 5% magic defense. Max stacks: 20
[*] New custom skill, Dragonskin: All damage received increases magic defenses and resistances 30% and 5% physical defense.
[*] Max stacks: 20 (Can be found in shops.)
[*] New custom skill, Vengeance: For each ally that dies, you gain 100% attack for 2 turns. Max stacks: 10 (Inspired by Caddeus idea) (Can be found in shops.)
[*] Liv’s “Guardian Potion” should be more balanced with the Ironhide change. Previously, Ironhide gained 30% physical AND magical defense along with resistances which at max stacks negated all damage types.  This made the  guardian potion extremely effective. (Can be found in shops.)
[*] Miltonius: any damage received, silences the attacker 1 turn.
[*] Jade and Max heroes now have voice audio from the Akumi Xtreme episodes.
[/list]
